verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 4 preserves the approved security design and corrects the two remaining dispatch-claim self-test fixtures to use the production receipt shape: the park-reason marker is emitted on its own top-level line. Those changes make the tests exercise the line-anchored parser instead of relying on the now-deliberately-invalid inline form. The shared sanitizer still defangs the reserved namespace at resolve-conflicts.py's App-authored publication choke point, and the reader independently accepts only whole, unquoted, unfenced receipt lines. The adversarial and genuine-receipt controls remain non-vacuous and cover both conflict and escalation sinks. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff. Progress is stagnant under the required scale because round 3 already had zero findings and this round also has zero findings.
